fields.name: error_name
fields.doc: The DOMException name a capture call rejected with, or the native adapter's mapped name. Never a message.

fields.name: permission_block
fields.doc: Where a capture refusal came from, when the browser can say. `system` is Chrome's 'denied by system' answer.

fields.name: display_capture_allowed
fields.doc: What document.featurePolicy said about display-capture before the picker ran. observed_false is a host policy block; unavailable_no_policy_api means the browser has no Feature Policy (Safari, Firefox); not_applicable on native.

fields.name: framed
fields.doc: window.self !== window.top when the capture ran: the app ran inside a frame, so a host page's allow= policy applies.

fields.name: display_surface
fields.doc: The displaySurface enum from the track's settings: which kind of surface the person picked. Never the surface's title.

fields.name: share_view_state
fields.doc: The state a share.view surface was in when shown: ScreenShareState plus ended on unmount.

fields.name: hidden
fields.doc: The share tile was hidden in the viewer's layout (pinned off or scrolled out).

fields.name: pinned_other
fields.doc: The viewer pinned a different item, which is why this share tile was hidden.

fields.name: pip
fields.doc: The share video element was the document's picture-in-picture element.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: The screen-share command a media_intent/media_result row describes.

fields.name: media_error_kind
fields.doc: The classified media error kind an sdk.telemetry media_result carries.

fields.name: mid
fields.doc: The RTP stream id a subscription or ingress row measures.

fields.name: packets
fields.doc: Cumulative packet count an sfu.media.ingress or viewer call_stats row reports.

fields.name: media_source
fields.doc: The published media source an SFU row names.

fields.name: publisher_id
fields.doc: The Participant whose publication a viewer's subscription row forwards.

fields.name: pause_reason
fields.doc: Why the SFU paused a subscription's forwarding.

fields.name: peer_state
fields.doc: The peer connection state an sfu.peer.state row reports.

fields.name: platform_kind
fields.doc: The platform a platform_changed or client row reports (web, ios, android).

fields.name: visibility_state
fields.doc: The app's foreground state a platform_changed row reports.

fields.name: stats
fields.doc: The call_stats row's JSON-encoded per-track rollup; the rule reads packets per mid from it.

fields.name: lease_state
fields.doc: What a sync_screen_share_leases read found: a live row, or none after release.

fields.name: owner_participant_id
fields.doc: The Participant a sync_screen_share_leases row names as its owner.

fields.name: owner_generation
fields.doc: The owner's participant generation a lease row holds.

fields.name: lease_id
fields.doc: The lease row's id, so two leases are never confused.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: The role a role_assigned row gave a Participant.

fields.name: capability
fields.doc: The moderation capability a Sync fact names.

fields.name: live_target_source
fields.doc: The media target a Sync live-target row changes.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The sdk.telemetry row's type discriminator on legacy rows.

fields.name: presented_frames
fields.doc: The video element's presented-frame count, or unavailable(native_render) on native.

fields.name: video_width
fields.doc: The decoded frame width; 0 means nothing decoded.

fields.name: rect_w
fields.doc: The element's on-screen width in device pixels.

fields.name: rect_h
fields.doc: The element's on-screen height in device pixels.

fields.name: on_screen
fields.doc: At least half the element's area is inside the viewport.

fields.name: page_visible
fields.doc: The page is visible (document.visibilityState).

fields.name: covered
fields.doc: Another element covers the share's center point.

fields.name: publication_id
fields.doc: The screen publication id the probe watches.

fields.name: connection_id
fields.doc: The media connection an SFU row belongs to.

events.name: share.capture
events.doc: The client's getDisplayMedia call and its terminal outcome: the screen picker a Participant answered, or the rejection it hit. Duration separates a picker cancel from a policy block.

events.name: share.track_ended
events.doc: The result of the client's attempt to report a track's ended event to Sync, replacing a discarded Effect.ignore.

events.name: share.view
events.doc: A viewer's committed share surface: mounted while it shows a state, dismissed at unmount. One shown record per state change carries that state and the layout flags.

events.name: share.start
events.doc: Sync's final answer to an enable-screen live target: granted, refused with a named reason, or failed on a dependency.

events.name: share.stop
events.doc: Sync's final answer to a disable-screen live target: the media_pause was committed, or it failed with a named reason.

events.name: share.publish
events.doc: The SFU's answer to a screen claim: the publication was accepted, or refused because a screen was already live or the node hit its packet ceiling.

events.name: share.db.lease
events.doc: A read of the sync_screen_share_leases row the checker itself takes: who owns the share lease, or that no row exists after release.

events.name: client.media_intent
events.doc: The SDK asked Sync to change a media target; for the screen share these are the share_start and share_stop intents.

events.name: client.media_result
events.doc: The SDK's record of Sync's reply to a media command, including the passed-through reason_code. A copy of Sync's decision, never a second witness.

events.name: client.call_stats
events.doc: The client's periodic call stats rollup; the share checks read a viewer's inbound packets per mid and recv bitrate from its stats payload.

events.name: client.platform_changed
events.doc: The client's foreground state changed; a viewer hidden before the window stays hidden until a later change.

events.name: client.sync_socket_open
events.doc: The viewer's Sync socket connected; tiles update from this point.

events.name: client.sync_socket_close
events.doc: The viewer's Sync socket closed; tiles freeze from this point until the next open.

events.name: sync.role_assigned
events.doc: Sync assigned a Participant a role; a capability_denied right after is a role race, not a fault.

events.name: sync.participant_screen_share_stopped
events.doc: A moderator's stopScreenOthers force-stopped a Participant's share; the stop was ordered, not a fault.

events.name: sfu.publication.started
events.doc: The SFU accepted a publication and began forwarding it; with media_source=screen it is the share going live on the node.

events.name: sfu.publication.stopped
events.doc: The SFU ended a publication; with media_source=screen the share stopped on the node.

events.name: sfu.media.ingress
events.doc: The node's periodic cumulative packet count per mid; growth on source=screen proves the sharer's device is sending.

events.name: sfu.subscription.started
events.doc: The SFU began forwarding a publication to a viewer; the viewer and the publisher's mid name the link.

events.name: sfu.subscription.paused
events.doc: The SFU paused forwarding to a viewer, with the reason: congestion, the viewer's own request, or an inactive source.

events.name: sfu.subscription.stopped
events.doc: The SFU stopped forwarding a publication to a viewer.

events.name: sfu.admission.refused
events.doc: The SFU's existing refusal log; a copy of share.publish's refused decision, never a second witness.

events.name: sfu.peer.state
events.doc: A peer's media connection state on the node; a share that never connected is slice 2's problem, not this one's.

events.name: video.render_probe
events.doc: Slice 4's render probe on a video element: presented frames, geometry and visibility, every 5 s while the tile mounts the track. Declared by slice 5 until slice 4's area lands its own; the emitter is slice 4's probe.

reasons.doc: Sync's lease refused the start because the Episode's one screen share is already held.
Sync refused the start because the Participant's role can't publish screen.
A Postgres write the share command needs failed; the command never reached its decision.
The SFU refused the claim because a screen publication is already live.
The SFU refused the claim because the node is at its packet ceiling.
The lease release deleted no row: the holder no longer owned it, so the row outlived the share.
The start hit capability_denied inside the role-change window; the Participant's role grant hadn't landed yet.
The refusal was honest: the lease owner's screen ingress was still growing.
The lease owner went silent without stopping; its row drains on the 35 s expiry.
A viewer's Sync socket was closed across the stop, so their stale tile is slice 7's drop, not this fault.
The viewer's page was hidden or backgrounded across the window, so nothing had to render.
The share played in picture-in-picture; the page tile need not paint it.
The viewer pinned another item, which hid the share tile by their own choice.
The SFU paused the viewer's subscription for congestion while their link was starved.
The OS or browser's system policy denied capture; Chrome reports it as permission_block=system.
The Participant dismissed the screen picker; the refusal took as long as a real picker.
A Permissions-Policy denied display-capture before any picker ran.
NotAllowedError arrived too fast for a picker with no system block and no policy block: the capture was refused silently.
InvalidStateError: the call ran without a live user activation.
The browser or context doesn't support display capture.
The getDisplayMedia call was malformed (OverconstrainedError or TypeError).
The capture device or an unmapped error stopped the share before the picker could answer.
The share stopped because the client's Sync link dropped for LONG_DROP_MS; slice 7 owns the drop.
A moderator paused the Participant's screen share.

machines.name: share.client
machines.doc: The sharer-side screen share in the client: idle until a start intent, live once the revision settles, stopping on an off intent.

machines.name: share.lease
machines.doc: The Episode's screen-share lease in Sync: held by one Participant until released or expired. Renew and rotate keep the lease held and emit no transition; their result is on the db row's renewed_until.

facts.name: share.capture
facts.doc: The Participant's screen-picker attempt and its terminal outcome. Claim: the op's outcome.

facts.name: share.command
facts.doc: Sync's answer to a share_start or share_stop command, with the client's media_result copy of the same reply as one witness. Claim: the decision or outcome.

facts.name: share.client_state
facts.doc: The sharer-side share.client transitions. Claim: to_state.

facts.name: share.lease_state
facts.doc: Who holds the Episode's screen-share lease: Sync's share.lease transitions and the lease table the checker reads. Claim: to_state or lease_state.

facts.name: share.publish
facts.doc: The SFU's decision on the Participant's screen claim, with its admission.refused log as the same witness. Claim: the decision.

facts.name: share.live
facts.doc: The sharer's screen picture reaching the node: publications and cumulative ingress on source=screen. Claim: packets for ingress rows.

facts.name: share.forward
facts.doc: A viewer's subscription to a screen publication: started, paused with its reason, stopped. Claim: the row's event state.

facts.name: share.receive
facts.doc: The viewer's inbound packets on the screen mid in a call_stats window, and their recv bitrate. Claim: packets.

facts.name: share.view
facts.doc: What state a viewer's share surface showed. Claim: share_view_state.

facts.name: share.client_presence
facts.doc: The viewer's platform state and Sync socket: hidden, backgrounded, or disconnected while a share changed.

facts.name: share.moderation
facts.doc: Sync's moderation evidence about a Participant: role assignments and a moderator's stop of their share.

facts.name: share.track_ended
facts.doc: The client's report of a screen track's ended event reaching Sync.

facts.name: share.render
facts.doc: Slice 4's render probe on the share's video element. Claim: presented_frames (or its unavailable marker).

symptoms.doc: The Participant picked a screen, but the share never went live for the Episode.
user_words: I shared my screen but nothing happened

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'share.capture' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The picker attempt that started the share and its outcome.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (name == 'share.start' or (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'media_result' and action == 'share_start')) | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Sync's share.start decision, or the client's media_result copy of it.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (event == 'share.publish' or event == 'sfu.admission.refused') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The SFU's decision on the screen claim.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event in ('sfu.publication.started', 'sfu.media.ingress', 'sfu.peer.state') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The screen publication and its ingress on the node.

symptoms.doc: The screen picker failed for a reason other than the Participant's own cancel or an OS refusal.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'share.capture' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The picker attempt, its error name, duration and policy fields.

symptoms.doc: A Participant was refused with screen_share_in_use while nobody was really sharing.
user_words: it says someone else is sharing but nobody is

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and (name == 'share.start' or name == 'share.stop' or (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'media_result' and action == 'share_start')) | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The refused share.start and the owner's earlier start and stop decisions.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and (name == 'share.lease' or name == 'share.db.lease') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The lease transitions and the lease row itself: who held it and whether release worked.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and event in ('sfu.publication.started', 'sfu.media.ingress') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether the owner's screen is still sending, or has drained.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'share.client' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether the owner asked to stop before the refusal.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'share.view' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: On the Cloudflare plane, a present viewer's share surface stands in for missing ingress.

symptoms.doc: The share is live at the SFU, but a present viewer has no visible picture of it.
user_words: the share is a black box

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and event in ('sfu.publication.started', 'sfu.media.ingress') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The share is live: a started screen publication with ingress growth.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event in ('sfu.subscription.started', 'sfu.subscription.paused', 'sfu.subscription.stopped') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The viewer's subscription to the screen mid and any pause.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'call_stats') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The viewer's inbound packets on the screen mid.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'share.view' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The viewer's share surface state and its hidden, pinned and PiP flags.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'video.render_probe' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Slice 4's render probe on the share element: on screen, visible and presenting frames.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type in ('platform_changed', 'sync_socket_open', 'sync_socket_close')) | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The viewer's page visibility and Sync socket across the window.

symptoms.doc: The viewer's share is on screen and packets arrive, but no new frame is presented.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event in ('sfu.subscription.started', 'sfu.subscription.paused', 'sfu.subscription.stopped') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The viewer's subscription to the screen mid.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'call_stats') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Packet growth on the screen mid inside a measured window.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'share.view' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The surface showing live or low-quality without PiP.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'video.render_probe' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Two on-screen probes 5 s apart with no presented-frame growth.

symptoms.doc: The Participant asked to stop, and 5 s later Sync hasn't stopped it, the SFU still receives it, or a viewer still shows it.
user_words: my screen is still being shared
I stopped sharing but they can still see it

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and name == 'share.client' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: The on→stopping transition that is the stop request and its trigger.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and (name == 'share.stop' or (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type == 'media_result' and action == 'share_stop')) | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Sync's share.stop decision for this stop.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event in ('sfu.media.ingress', 'sfu.publication.stopped') | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: Whether the sharer's screen ingress kept growing after the stop deadline.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and name == 'share.view' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: A present viewer's last share state before the deadline.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and (event == 'sdk.telemetry' and type in ('sync_socket_open', 'sync_socket_close')) | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: A viewer whose Sync socket was closed across the stop is slice 7's stale tile.

witnesses.query: axiom chalk-logs | where episode_id == '{episode}' and participant_id == '{participant}' and event == 'participant_screen_share_stopped' | where _time between (datetime({from}) .. datetime({to}))
witnesses.doc: A moderation_pause stop is expected when Sync logged the moderator's stop.
